20260717194541_harden_security_audit_remediation.sql previously compared pg_get_userbyid(relowner) = current_user and reported with `raise notice`. Measured on PostgreSQL 16.15 it created ZERO storage.objects policies under an owner while exiting 0 and reporting nothing, because the guard is a strict subset of the server's pg_class_ownercheck and client_min_messages = warning suppresses the NOTICE. The application_documents_public_read drop and the application_documents_select_own hardening are now attempted against the server in their own subtransaction. This is a real authorization improvement for the hiring-PII document bucket, not only a replay fix.

The insert into storage.buckets for the application-documents bucket is now guarded the same way, so a replay role that cannot write storage.buckets no longer aborts the chain at 20260717194541 before 20260914090000_revoke_public_execute_db002.sql is ever reached.
